summary: Display adapter capability query for a selected display (a2[65]). Dispatches surface-format and multisample capability tests through vtable slots +20/+24/+36/+44/+52 on the sub-object at this+0x10FC, accumulating a support bitmask in *a2, then enumerates display modes (slots +32/+24/+28) and reports the modes that pass the resolution window this+0x1508..this+0x1510 to sub_55BC00. Logs aErrorEnumDispl / aCouldNotGetCur through sub_53C590 and returns -1 on failure. Invoked by DisplayModeEnumeratorWrapper (0x0055BBF0).

local_names.this: display adapter wrapper object holding the graphics sub-object and resolution constraints
local_names.a2: capability bitmask output; a2[65] is the selected display index, a2[68]/a2[69] are cleared output slots
local_names.v5: return value of the format 23/23 capability test
local_names.v6: return value of the format 24/25 capability test
local_names.v7: return value of the format 24/24 capability test
local_names.v8: return value of the format 20/20 capability test
local_names.v9: return value of the format 22/22 capability test
local_names.v10: return value of the format 22/21 capability test
local_names.v11: return value of the slot +52 mode-info query
local_names.v13: format-descriptor output field driving bitmask bits
local_names.v14: current value of *a2 during bitmask assembly
local_names.v23: selected display index re-read as a2[65]
local_names.v24: return value of the current-mode query (slot +32)
local_names.v26: return value of the mode enumeration call (slot +28)
local_names.v29: resolved width for the current/mode resolution
local_names.v30: resolved height for the current/mode resolution
local_names.v35: output buffer for the current-mode query
local_names.v37: output buffer for the mode-info query

operations.description: Gets surface data for the selected display a2[65] through vtable slot +20 on the sub-object at this+0x10FC, writing into buffer v41 and storing the result in this+0x0
When the stack-sentinel check v42 == 4170 passes, resets the object state via StateIntSetter4(this, -1, -1, 1024, 768)
Tests surface format 23/23 capability via vtable slot +36; on failure ORs 0x1000000 into the capability bitmask *a2; the result is stored in this+0x0
Tests surface format 24/25 capability via slot +36; on failure ORs 0x2000000 into *a2
Tests surface format 24/24 capability via slot +36; on failure ORs 0x4000000 into *a2
Tests surface format 20/20 capability via slot +36; on failure ORs 0x8000000 into *a2
Tests surface format 22/22 capability via slot +36; on failure ORs 0x20000000 into *a2
Tests surface format 22/21 capability via slot +36; on failure ORs 0x10000000 into *a2
Queries mode-info data for the display via vtable slot +52 into buffer v37; a non-zero result makes the function return -1

Assembles the capability bitmask in *a2 from format-descriptor output fields: v40 0x10000 selects bit 4, v40 0x100000 selects 0x400000, v40 0x80000 selects bit 8, v38 0x80000 selects bit 1, v39 low bit selects 0x10
Tests multisample type 2 via slot +44 on formats 23 and 22; failure of either ORs 0x20 into *a2
Tests multisample type 3 via slot +44; failure ORs 0x80 into *a2
Tests multisample type 4 via slot +44; failure ORs 0x40 into *a2
Tests multisample type 6 via slot +44; failure ORs 0x200 into *a2
Tests multisample type 16 via slot +44; failure ORs 0x80000 into *a2
Clears a2[68] and a2[69], then gets the current display mode via vtable slot +32 into buffer v35; on failure logs aCouldNotGetCur through sub_53C590 and returns -1
Resolves the current mode's resolution via sub_55C450, using format id 21 when the mode format v36 equals 22
Queries the display-mode count via vtable slot +24; when it is not positive, logs aErrorEnumDispl through sub_53C590 and returns -1
Enumerates each display mode 0..count-1 via vtable slot +28 into v31/v32 (width/height), storing each call result in this+0x0 and re-testing the mode's surface format v34 through slot +36

Filters enumerated modes: skips the duplicate low resolutions (width 0x2C0/0x2D0/0x358 at height 480 and width 0x3C0/0x500 at height 720), then keeps modes inside the window v31 >= this+0x1508, v32 >= this+0x150C, v31 <= this+0x1510 and v32 <= this+0x1510
For modes passing the resolution filter, delegates to sub_55BC00(v31, v32, v30, v33)
Invoked by DisplayModeEnumeratorWrapper (0x0055BBF0) as the capability/mode-enumeration stage

type 2 fail -> 0x20; type 3 fail -> 0x80; type 4 fail -> 0x40;

re-test format v36/v34 via slot +36 with multisample 1;
if ((v31,v32) is one of the duplicate low resolutions) continue;
